entry.description: Logan+Lynn 2-hero combo — Inf+Lanc class heroes. Lynn S1 has 40% chance (RNG). WIP attacks (no hero, t6 inf+lanc+mark), minxxx defends with Logan+Lynn. Run 5 battles.

Logan+Lynn 2-hero combo — Inf+Lanc class heroes. Lynn S1 has 40% chance (RNG). minxxx attacks with Logan+Lynn (600 troops), WIP defends (no hero, 1800 troops). 3:1 troop disadvantage for hero side. Placed as attackers so widget defense bonuses (S4) do not fire, making the fight competitive. Run 5 battles.

Logan+Lynn 2-hero combo — Inf+Lanc class heroes. Lynn S1 has 40% chance (RNG). minxxx attacks with Logan+Lynn (600 troops), WIP defends (no hero, 1800 troops). 3:1 troop disadvantage for hero side. Placed as attackers so widget defense bonuses (S4) do not fire, making the fight competitive. Run 5 battles.
Lynn solo defender test. WIP attacking no heroes 1500/1500/1500, minxxx defending with Lynn (3/3/3). Balanced around 0 outcome.
Molly+Lynn 2-hero combo — Lanc+Mark class heroes. Lynn S1 has 40% chance. RNG test, run 5 battles. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 troops), minxxx defends with Molly+Lynn.

WOS-444 Gordon S2/2 all-enemy damage-dealt-down bucket probe. WIP attacks 2700 each T6 mixed; minxxx defends Gordon+Sergey+Lynn with 2560 T6 lancer. Candidate signed remaining scores: damage.down +558, attack.down +593, lethality.down -143.
Alonso+Norah 2-hero combo — Mark+Lanc class heroes. Alonso has chance-based skills; Norah S2 splash. RNG test, run 5 battles. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 troops), minxxx defends with Alonso+Norah.
Alonso+Norah 2-hero combo — Mark+Lanc class heroes. Alonso has chance-based skills; Norah S2 splash. RNG test, run 5 battles. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 troops), minxxx defends with Alonso+Norah.
Alonso+Norah 2-hero combo — Mark+Lanc class heroes. Alonso has chance-based skills; Norah S2 splash. RNG test, run 5 battles. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 troops), minxxx defends with Alonso+Norah.
Bahiti (Marksman) + Norah (Lancer) combo — both heroes fully deterministic, single run sufficient. Tests Marksman+Lancer pairing and Norah's splash interaction with Bahiti's buffs.

Gwen (Marksman class) + Norah (Infantry class) combo defender — no chance skills, deterministic. Tests frequency-based skill stacking: Gwen fires extra marksmen attacks every 4-5 attacks, Norah fires lancer splash. WIP attacks clean; minxxx defends.
Norah+Greg 2-hero combo — Lanc+Mark class heroes. Greg has chance-based skills; Norah S2 splash. RNG test, run 5 battles. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 troops), minxxx defends with Norah+Greg.

Norah+Hector+Zinman 3-hero combo — Lanc+Inf+Mark class heroes. Norah S2 splash, Zinman has chance-based skills. RNG test, run 5 battles. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 troops), minxxx defends with all three heroes.

WOS-27: Norah S2 primary-target test. WIP attacks with 1,000 T6 infantry and no heroes; minxxx defends with 50/50/50 T6 and Norah 2/2/2. Four captured endpoints are 643, 643, 646, and 645 WIP infantry survivors. Battle Details recorded 20, 21, 16, and 16 S2 procs across the four runs (the two 643 runs had 20 and 21), with 3 displayed kills at the game's 35% reporting scale in every run.

WOS-27: Norah S2 non-primary fan-out test — Scenario A (Norah active). WIP has infantry+marksmen ONLY (no lancers), minxxx has lancers ONLY + Norah S1=1/S2=1. Lancers always target infantry (primary). Any marksmen casualties must come from S2 extra_vs_all fan-out. Compare marksmen survivors vs Scenario B (no heroes).

WOS-27 S2 fan-out control: WIP infantry-only vs minxxx 200 lancers + Norah S1=1/S2=1. Measures infantry casualties with Norah active, no marksmen present so fan-out has no target. Compare to Scenario C (no Norah) for S1+S2 infantry effect. Then delta(C→D) vs delta(B→A) isolates whether extra casualties in A are marksmen (fan-out) or more infantry.

Norah solo defender test. WIP attacking no heroes 1500/1069/1500 t6, minxxx defending with Norah (1/1/0). Tests S1 (Combined arms: -dmg taken/+dmg dealt for inf+mark) and S2 (Sneak strike: 20% chance 40% extra lancer damage).

Norah+Zinman 2-hero combo — Lanc+Mark class heroes, both NC (no chance skills), single run definitive. Norah S2 splash on lancer attacks; Zinman has attack-frequency DamageUp. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 600/600/600), minxxx defends with Norah+Zinman.

Sergey+Norah+Zinman 3-hero combo — Inf+Lanc+Mark class heroes, all NC (no chance skills), single run definitive. Tests 3-class buff stacking with deterministic skills. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 800/800/800), minxxx defends with all three heroes.

Molly solo attacker test. minxxx attacking WIP with Molly (2/2/1), WIP defending no heroes. Tests S1 (Calling of the storm: 40% chance -20% dmg taken), S2 (Ice Dominion: 50% chance +20% dmg dealt), S3 (Youthful rage: permanent +5% dmg dealt).
Natalia solo defender test. WIP attacking no heroes 1500/1069/1500, minxxx defending with Natalia (2/2). Attacker wins with 2664 survivors.
